promptZh: 从下面七个选项中为五个空格选出最恰当的句子。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文记叙生物老师把校园荒地改成学生花园，从少数人参与到全班收益，并带来学习方式的变化。
explanation.ruleZh: 叙事类七选五要抓住时间线和情感变化，空格前后的人数、学科、活动等细节是选句的关键线索。

distractors.reasonZh: 关闭花园与全文热情扩大花园的走向相反。
超市蔬菜更好吃与亲手种植收获的自豪感相矛盾。

sharedOptions.text: Standing there with mud on our shoes, we felt proud of what a piece of waste ground had become.
Word spread quickly, and classmates kept asking how they could help.
There were failures too: a dry week left the soil hard, and a rabbit once ate half of our carrots.
Soon other subjects moved outdoors as well.
The school then decided to close the garden for the winter.
Most importantly, the garden gave quiet students a chance to shine.
The vegetables we bought from the supermarket tasted better.

segments.text: Last September, our biology teacher, Ms. Chen, turned a piece of waste ground behind the school into a garden. At first, only a few students joined the project.

Soon, however, more than sixty names were on the watering list, and teachers began bringing their classes outside.

Each class took care of its own bed. We planted lettuce, tomatoes and sunflowers, and kept a diary of their growth.

When the first tomatoes turned red, we carried them to the school kitchen, and the cook made a salad for the whole grade.

The garden also changed how we study. Facts from the textbook became things we could touch and taste.
In geography we measured rainfall and drew charts of it; in English we wrote instructions for planting.

One classmate who hardly ever spoke in class turned out to be an insect expert, and we listened to him as carefully as we listen to our teachers.

In June we held a small harvest festival beside the flower beds. Parents were invited, and the money from selling vegetables went to the village school library.
Ms. Chen says the garden will double in size next autumn, and this time nobody doubts it.

gaps.explanationZh: 前句说起初只有少数学生参加，后句说浇水名单超过六十人，o2 消息传开承上启下。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 种植过程并非一帆风顺
gaps.explanationZh: 前句写日常照料，后句写第一批番茄送进厨房，o3 补充过程中的失败再转入收获。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说课本知识变得可触可尝，后句举例地理和英语课移到室外，o4 概括其他学科也搬到户外。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 后句写内向同学的表现
gaps.explanationZh: 后句写从不发言的同学成了昆虫专家，o6 给安静的学生提供了闪耀机会正是这一例子的概括。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句写义卖收入捐给乡村学校图书馆，后句说明年花园将翻倍，o1 写站在园中的自豪感收束全文。
